[i][b]Welkis City[/b]

[u]Command Bunker beneath the Central Mall District[/u]

The concrete walls shook as muffled gunfire echoed above. Hikman Eikira leaned over the steel operations table, maps of Wellgoes Isle scattered with red and blue markers. Sweat rolled down his temples as his adjutant rushed in, face pale.

Adjutant: Governor Eikira, the mall district has turned. Furry partisansarmed, organized, theyve taken over the east wing. Loyalists are fighting inside the shops and upper levels. Reports of Molotovs, improvised explosives Its spreading fast.

Hikman Eikira: slams his fist on the table Damn it! I told them to scour the city weeks ago. You let them burrow into our streets like rats! Now they strike at the heart of my city, while the mainland burns in treachery.

He walked to the underground slit window, watching smoke rise from the central boulevard. Sounds of shouting and machine-gun fire filtered down from above.
Communications Officer: Sir, we still hold the SRBM batteries. But loyalist morale is cracking. Many have families from off northern mainland. If they believe the city is falling, they might
Hikman Eikira: snaps They will obey my orders. Anyone caught hesitating will be executed as a traitor. Deploy the Leopards to the mall perimeterseal the district off entirely. I want that marketplace drowned in fire if we must!

Another blast thundered, rattling the room. A runner stumbled in, clothes torn, helmet cracked.
Runner: Governor! Theyve taken the tram station! Furries armed with captured weapons are pushing into the mall concourse. Civilians are joining them, our men cant hold them back without armor support!

Hikman Eikira (coldly, after a long pause)

 Then drown them. Gas the lower tunnels, collapse the exits, burn them alive if we must. Welkis belongs to me, and if these creatures think they can rise, well show them Oceanice steel.
He turned to his adjutant, voice lowering but coldly.

Still if the paratroopers are truly coming, this uprising may not be a coincidence. They may be baiting us, drawing our armor away from the SRBMs. If I fall for it, the missiles are lost.
He straightened, grim, his shadow falling over the map of the island.

Very well. Hold the SRBMs at all costs. Sacrifice Welkis if we must. Let the furries choke on their own smoke and rubble. When reinforcements come, this island will still answer to me.[/i]
